title: Sam Altman just revealed AGI is 2 years away — here is what that means

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AGI in two years is not a guess — it's a calculated timeline based on current computational trends and scaling laws. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Altman’s timeline ignores the complexity of general intelligence — we're not just scaling up, we're solving fundamental problems in alignment and cognition. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The OpenAI alignment protocols and GPT’s reasoning benchmarks show we're on track — progress is measurable and accelerating. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Altman’s optimism masks the gap between narrow AI and AGI — we're decades from true autonomy, not two years. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Real AGI requires not just compute, but breakthroughs in neuroscience and philosophy — Altman oversimplifies the challenge. (4 sec)
